services.name: Castle.io
services.research_note: Chinaready's nationwide mainland probes of api.castle.io across 148 city/carrier paths all returned HTTP and DNS high latency — treat the Castle API as unavailable in China. Prefer NetEase Yidun and GeeTest for lightweight SaaS trials; prefer Alibaba Cloud Risk Identification or Tencent Cloud Tianyu when you already run on those clouds.
